claim: Wait out each original routine's exact T states by path, taken from replays, rather than using a K ratio of body time.
limit: Best where the time is a simple function of the arguments.

evidence.text: A K window was wrong in both directions: K is a ratio of body time, and the body's clock ratio differs by path (LDI heavy against register heavy). Replays give the original routines' exact T by path; waiting those out gave +0.1% against +-5%.
evidence.quote: Replays give the original routines' exact T by path; waiting those out gave +0.1% against +-5%, and needs no tuning per emulator.
